meta.name: obsidian-skills-integrated
meta.description: 内容创作者与技术写作员在让AI撰写Obsidian笔记时，使用此官方技能可精准处理双链、Callout及Bases数据库语法，一键生成格式零破坏的Canvas画布与专业笔记，彻底解决AI破坏专属格式的痛点。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让AI生成格式正确的Obsidian笔记
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用AI写Obsidian笔记但总担心格式被破坏
copy.tagline_en: Generate Obsidian notes with correct formatting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI to write Obsidian notes but worry about broken formatting

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按 Obsidian 官方语法生成笔记,正确处理双链、Callout、Frontmatter 等;也能生成 Canvas 画布文件和 Bases 数据库文件,避免破坏这些专属格式。
howto.when: 当用户要求按 Obsidian 格式写笔记、生成 Canvas 画布或操作 Bases 数据库时触发。

say.text: 请用 json-canvas 画一个项目流程图,标注节点和连接线。
请用 obsidian-bases 建一个读书清单数据库,带排序视图和过滤器。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write Obsidian notes with official syntax, correctly handling wikilinks, callouts, frontmatter, and more. It can also create Canvas canvas files and Bases database files, avoiding damage to these Obsidian-specific formats.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests Obsidian-formatted notes, Canvas generation, or Bases database operations.

say_en.text: Create a note using obsidian-markdown with a wikilink and an INFO callout.
say_en.note: Claude generates a .md file with Obsidian syntax.

say_en.text: Use json-canvas to draw a project diagram with nodes and edges.
Use obsidian-bases to make a reading list with a sorted view and filter.
